title: An algebraic element over an algebraic intermediate field is algebraic over the base
statement: Let $K\subseteq L\subseteq M$ be a compatible tower of fields [def-pc-field-extension]. Suppose every element of $L$ is algebraic over $K$ [def-weil-algebraic-element]. For every $a\in M$, if $a$ is algebraic over $L$, then $a$ is algebraic over $K$.
